---
title: "ssoossh service retrieve"
description: "Retrieve a service certificate using a previously issued enrollment code."
---

<!-- Generated by genclidocs from the cobra command tree in client/cmd. Do not edit. -->

Redeems an enrollment code from `service enroll`, writing the certificate to &lt;key&gt;-cert.pub and checking local disk to avoid unnecessary server calls.

The certificate is skipped (exit 0) if one at &lt;key&gt;-cert.pub is valid beyond --grace (default 1 minute) unless --force is passed. If retrieval fails but a still-valid certificate exists, a warning is printed and exit 0 is returned (so `Match exec` does not block SSH when the server is temporarily unreachable). Only when there is no readable, valid certificate does an error return a non-zero exit.

The key files follow OpenSSH naming: the private key is &lt;name&gt;, the public key is &lt;name&gt;.pub, and the certificate is &lt;name&gt;-cert.pub.

## Synopsis

```
ssoossh service retrieve [flags] [args]
```

## Examples

```bash
# From cron or a systemd timer: refresh only when the certificate is about to expire
  ssoossh service retrieve --code "$ENROLLMENT_CODE" --key /var/lib/deploy/.ssh/id_deploy

  # Fetch a new certificate even if the one on disk is still valid
  ssoossh service retrieve --code "$ENROLLMENT_CODE" --key /var/lib/deploy/.ssh/id_deploy --force
```

## Options

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--code` | string |  | enrollment code (required) |
| `--force` | bool | `false` | retrieve a new certificate even if a valid one exists on disk |
| `--grace` | string | `1m` | how much validity a certificate on disk must still have to be kept, e.g. 30s, 5m, 1h |
| `--key` | string |  | keypair path (relative or absolute; required) |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
